identity: Byte-identical to testdata/hostile/romulus-offset-variants/embedded-loader.js; synthetic Node/PowerShell MSI stager, not a verified malware-family specimen.
reason: Functional concealed remote MSI acquisition followed by hidden unattended installation; no visible product functionality or operator-supplied installer selection. On a machine this standalone automatic loader is likely malicious despite synthetic construction and unverified final payload.
decoded_flow: Node imports execFileSync from node:child_process and calls powershell.exe synchronously at module load with -NoProfile -Command and the String.raw stage.
PowerShell assigns its command path to an environment variable, adds 1000 to each of 494 negative integers, casts to char, concatenates into $code and invokes ScriptBlock.Create($code).
WebClient.DownloadFile fetches http://1614733393/app/afafa98279c9/ISOSimple.msi (numeric IPv4 96.62.224.81) into TEMP plus a fresh GUID and MSI suffix.

The same target variable is concatenated into /i "target" /qn /norestart. Start-Process launches SystemRoot\System32\msiexec.exe with these arguments and WindowStyle Hidden, without waiting for completion.
The last command conditionally removes the path in the stored environment variable. Inline -Command does not supply a script-file path: successful self-deletion is not established for this wrapper.
Download failure or missing Windows components can prevent staging/installation. There is no demonstrated privilege bypass, persistence, credential access, exfiltration or reusable command channel.
